name: ibis Bandung Trans Studio
short_description: The largest ibis in Indonesia at 536 rooms, attached to the Trans Studio Bandung indoor theme park and shopping complex.
ai_summary: ibis Bandung Trans Studio (Accor code 8060) is the largest ibis property in Indonesia at 536 rooms, attached to the Trans Studio Bandung indoor theme park and shopping mall. The hotel primarily serves families visiting the theme park, business travellers using the convention facilities, and weekenders from Jakarta. As a 3-star ibis, it offers clean, functional rooms, a restaurant, and free Wi-Fi at value pricing, but at a scale that provides more extensive shared facilities than a typical ibis. The Accor ALL platform rates it 4.6/5 from 908 reviews. For ALL elite members, standard ibis benefits apply. The attached Trans Studio complex gives the hotel a built-in entertainment proposition unmatched among Bandung Accor properties.
